Request changes: one P1 regression in existing-local-branch session startup. Reviewed all nine files of the full supplied binary diff against protected main fd4018a2b2fada46b4d110d11cd446d7fe65d293 and landing tree f4a7b11958fc0c2e01e00ff302dbe3c72d212714; attestation target is original PR head 165c6f83ec9fb235762197ec6a0717162b1ebd5a. The finding is present in both original head and landing tree, with no dependency on intervening protected-base changes. No other actionable defects found.

Covered spec: BUG-2211. There is no formal Acceptance/Verify section. The following enumerates its description criteria and later authoritative refinements; verified means source/evidence inspection, not reviewer-executed tests.
BUG-2211 criterion 1, reopened advisor criterion: avoid the upstream config write in sandboxed seat/worktree creation OR safely recover the stale zero-byte lock — verified by --no-track in fresh session, pooled checkout, dispatch reset/new worktree, epic worktree and rendered brief paths, plus existing aida-core/src/git_ops/config_lock.rs output_healing_config_lock. Added tests assert unchanged config under branch.autoSetupMerge=always: cargo test -p aida-cli-lib setup_block_fresh_branch_matches_work_convention and cargo test -p aida-cli-lib add_creates_worktree_with_focus_then_is_idempotent (commands identified only, not run). Existing-local-branch compatibility has the blocking regression described in findings.
BUG-2211 criterion 2, doctor detects and offers/performs safe placeholder removal — verified by aida-cli-lib/src/sandbox_config_lock.rs scan, doctor/sandbox.rs heal_doctor_sandbox_config_lock, and existing reports_the_placeholder_as_safe_to_heal, ignores_a_real_or_writable_lock and heal_removes_only_the_placeholder test definitions. The helper requires a non-symlink regular file, zero length and exact mode 0444.
BUG-2211 criterion 3, launch/worktree creation uses shared recovery before config writes — verified by session_start.rs transactional_worktree_add using output_healing_config_lock, agent_launch.rs calling session_start_with_receipt, and worktree_gc.rs ensure_epic_worktree_core using the same helper; pooled and dispatch branch creation now suppress tracking writes directly. Existing aida-core/src/git_ops/config_lock.rs tests include placeholder_is_removed_and_worktree_add_succeeds and placeholder_recreated_after_the_pre_clear_is_cleared_and_retried_once.
BUG-2211 criterion 4, initial age/no-holder heuristic — not-applicable-because later root-cause guidance replaces it with the empty exact-mode-0444 placeholder signature, and reopened advisor guidance permits prevention or recovery.
BUG-2211 criterion 5, original sandbox-primary Git-write warning/refusal hook direction — not-applicable-because the subsequent reopened advisor instruction accepts avoiding upstream writes or cleaning the stale lock instead; no new hook behavior is claimed.
Type protocol BUG-2211 (bug protocol: touches at least one test file): met; aida-cli-lib/src/tests/task_492_brief_tests.rs and aida-cli-lib/src/tests/worktree_handler_tests.rs are modified.

CI pending at review time: exact-head CI (fast gates) and merge-hold-gate passed; CI (fast compile) completed cargo check --profile dev --workspace --tests and was still running Ratchet set. No local test/build commands were run under reviewer policy. Pending CI is not the reason for request-changes. The existing-branch failure is established by source inspection and Git 2.43.0's add implementation, https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.43.0/builtin/worktree.c#L852-L868. Reviewed trace comments, documentation/templates, fresh/remote-only/local-existing branch choices, pooled creation, dispatch reset, rollback argument handling and both changed tests. No branch updates, fixes, merge, or canonical recording performed.
kind.recovery_hint: address the review findings, move BUG-2211 back to In Progress, and clear the PR hold only after approval
